description: Main frontend source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe app using Ocean Professional theme. Contains theme setup, main app widget, home screen with mode selection, game screen with board, score management, and AI logic.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget initializing the app with themed MaterialApp and home screen.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Screen allowing user to select game mode (vs Player or vs Computer).

classes.name: _ModeCard
classes.description: Interactive card widget for selecting game modes, with press animation.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main game interface featuring the Tic Tac Toe board, score, turn indicator, and game logic including AI moves.

classes.name: _TurnIndicator
classes.description: UI component showing which player's turn it is.

classes.name: _PlayerChip
classes.description: UI element representing a player, highlighting current turn.

classes.name: _ScoreBar
classes.description: Displays current game scores for X, O, and draws.

classes.name: _Board
classes.description: Grid view rendering the game board cells.

classes.name: _BoardCell
classes.description: Individual cell widget with tap and visual feedback.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, launches the TicTacToeApp.

methods.name: _buildTheme
methods.description: Constructs the custom Material 3 theme with Ocean Professional palette.

methods.name: _startGame
methods.description: Navigates to GameScreen with selected mode.

methods.name: _onCellTap
methods.description: Handles user tap on board cell, updates game state.

methods.name: _evaluateBoardAndMaybeContinue
methods.description: Checks for winner or draw after each move, triggers dialogs.

methods.name: _makeComputerMove
methods.description: AI logic to choose move and update board for computer player.

methods.name: _detectWinner
methods.description: Determines if a player has won the game.

methods.name: _isBoardFull
methods.description: Checks if all board cells are filled.

methods.name: _showEndDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog declaring winner or draw, with options.

methods.name: _chooseBestAIMove
methods.description: Basic AI move selection prioritizing immediate wins or blocks, then center, corners, edges.
